description: Hook registrations for zeroes-ones/Skills — session-start injection, code protection, and caching infrastructure.

SessionStart.name: inject-meta-router
SessionStart.description: Injects using-agent-skills meta-router into every session so agents always know how to discover skills

PreToolUse.name: simplify-ignore
PreToolUse.description: Protects code blocks marked with simplify-ignore-start/end from accidental modification during code simplification

PreToolUse.name: sdd-cache-pre
PreToolUse.description: Checks WebFetch cache with HTTP revalidation (If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since) to skip redundant fetches

PostToolUse.name: sdd-cache-post
PostToolUse.description: Stores WebFetch responses with ETag/Last-Modified validators for future cache revalidation
